beats.say: The hardest moment on shift is not always clinical. Sometimes, it is the next sentence you say.
What do I tell a worried family? How do I escalate this? Was my handover clear?
Each day, one real moment from a working shift. Think first, choose, then see feedback that names what worked, and what to try next.
Short lessons, visual guides, a handover builder and practice you can see.
One useful minute a day. Start free today.
